assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with supraventricular tachycardia
occurring against a background of known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances in an outpatient setting
The claim is for Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229)
The denial is based on Reason Code CO-197
The required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered
The diagnosis code I25.10 is associated with atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery
